home.aboutText: I am 23 years old and live in Berlin. I hold a Bachelor's degree in Geoinformation with a focus on Geoinformatics. During my studies I discovered my passion for programming, especially app and web development. Since winter 2023 I have been studying for my Master's in Media Informatics at the Berliner Hochschule für Technik.
